A finite exposing tilt preserves the own trace and strictly excludes every other bounded fiber, including their boundary. This produces actual caps of mass q, not an arbitrary assignment of fractions.

A positive posterior mean is strictly on the inner side of the selected facet because at least one positive-weight site is off it. Applying the facet functional to a linear dependence gives zero sum of coefficients; affine independence then gives their individual vanishing. The positive factors in the covariance preserve rank.

For ternary sites, each selected corner exposes itself with dot-product gap at least one. The selected corners lie at z_n=1, the shifted column differences are −2e_i, and the determinant magnitude is 2^(n−1)(1−m_n)>0. The cap mass Γ_d/3^n is strictly below Γ_d/2^n and 3^−n<2^−n. Rational replay in dimensions one through four independently checked the margin and determinant arithmetic.

At the original center, base reflection gives a closed base halfspace of mass at least one half on which the through-mark cap dominates a centroid trace, yielding Γ_d/2 with the declared predecessor. The selected groups omit other fibers. Tightness is at q only, without any claim of an original global small-cap cover or deepest mark from the rank argument.
